## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` is green (lint, typecheck, build, unit/UI tests)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` is green when the change touches the browser, simulator, runner, judge or demo chatbot
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Changelog fragment added under `changelog.d/` (not `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/architecture.md` or an ADR) when behaviour or configuration changed
- [ ] No secrets, model API keys or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots
